component: Front disc brake pad axle set
release_gate: Removed pad outline, backing ears, thickness, and caliper/rotor clearance must match before payment.
notes: Autostore Pakistan PKR 6600 and PKR 17200 pad listings are useful local quote leads only; their visible OEM numbers/fitments are later Land Cruiser/Hilux families or 04465-60020, not a blind-buy approval for this J40. See data/manual/front_disc_local_quote_snapshot_20260530.csv.

release_gate: Old pin length, diameter, hole/clip style, and pad/caliper fit must match.
notes: Reference price is for the full BR06158K kit shared by pins, springs, and clips; do not count this price three times.

release_gate: Old spring shape, wire diameter, free width, and caliper/pad contact points must match.
notes: Toyota 47748-60010 is the separate spring reference if a complete pin kit is unavailable.

release_gate: Old clip count, clip wire shape, pin-hole fit, and installed retention must match.
notes: Clip quantity is tracked separately because missing clips can make a pad set unsafe even if the pads fit.

component: Pad shims or abutment pieces if fitted
release_gate: Quote only after one front pad set is removed and the old shim/abutment pieces are photographed.
notes: Do not invent this purchase. Some pad sets include backing/shim pieces and some old fixed-caliper setups use reusable abutment/contact pieces; replace only if present, worn, missing, or required by the mechanic.

component: Front Sumitomo fixed 4-piston calipers - professional rebuild original pair or matched rebuilt/new pair
preferred_source: Local brake caliper rebuilder by old cores / CruiserTeq BRC60021LOAD import reference
release_gate: Old caliper casting marks, RH/LH orientation, piston count/diameter, inlet/bridge pipe, bleeder, mounting ears, and rebuild bench test must match before payment.
notes: Toyota GR Heritage lists 47730-60021 RH and 47750-60021 LH for the old Land Cruiser front disc family, but the current truck still controls by sample. Local price remains quote-required; raw used calipers are cores only.

component: Front vented brake rotor replacement pair
preferred_source: Toyota 43512-60011 / local Toyota-Land Cruiser parts counter
release_gate: Old rotor OD, thickness, height/offset, 100 mm register, 139.7 mm PCD, 6+2 holes, hub fit, dust-shield/caliper/wheel clearance must match.
notes: Pakistan online rotor hits found on 2026-05-30 were Prado/GX/V8 listings and are price anchors only. Do not machine/reuse old rotors as the baseline plan.

component: Front lower wheel flexible brake hoses
preferred_source: SNA/Montgomery brake hose shop by old sample / Cruiser Corps 553-102 reference
release_gate: Old hose free length, chassis end, caliper or short-hard-line end, thread/seat or banjo style, bracket groove, retaining clip, and full-lock/droop clearance must match.
notes: Local quote should be for complete crimped automotive brake hose assemblies rated DOT/SAE J1401 or OEM-equivalent. No generic hose cut from roll.

component: Front upper/frame flexible brake hose if fitted
preferred_source: SNA/Montgomery brake hose shop by old sample / 553-101 reference
release_gate: Confirm this hose is actually fitted before quoting; then match free length, end fittings, bracket groove, retaining clip, hose rating, and route clearance.
notes: Do not create a permanent purchase if the current front setup has only the two lower wheel hoses.
